title: DONAUKIZZ KIZOMBA FESTIVAL 2027
description:
DONAUKIZZ KIZOMBA FESTIVAL 2027 – 5TH EDITION – WHERE PASSION MEETS PERFECTION
Get ready for the most anticipated Kizomba festival of the year! The DonauKizz Festival returns for its fifth spectacular edition, promising an unforgettable weekend of dance, passion, and pure joy in a family-friendly atmosphere.
✨ WHEN & WHERE
February 26 – February 28, 2027
Ballhaus Ulm – Wooden dance floors & beautiful ambiance
Just 4km from the picturesque Ulm city center.
WHY YOU CAN’T MISS THIS:
• 40 HOURS of pure dance magic:
• 14 hours of workshops with international artists
• 8 hours of social dancing
• 18 hours of electrifying parties
• Premium wooden dance floor for the perfect flow
